gloss: Go stone; game piece for Go

definitions.gloss: Go stone; game piece for Go
definitions.explanation: The round, flat stones used as playing pieces in the board game Go (囲碁). They come in two colors — black (黒石) and white (白石) — and are placed on the intersections of a grid.

⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧な{碁石|ごいし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{蛤|はまぐり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{作|つく}られている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: High-quality Go stones are made from clamshells.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{碁|ご}→碁：02138_go⟧ (Go, the board game) and ⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧ (stone). Traditional high-quality white stones are made from {蛤|はまぐり} (hard clam) shells from {日向|ひゅうが} in Miyazaki Prefecture, while black stones are made from {那智黒石|なちぐろいし} (Nachi black stone), a type of slate. Everyday sets use glass or plastic.
